description: This file contains the implementation of the NavigationManager class, which manages navigation menus, including building, merging, URL computation, authorization filtering, and reduction of menu items within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: NavigationManager
classes.description: A class responsible for building and managing navigation menus, including merging menu items, computing URLs, and filtering based on permissions.

methods.name: BuildMenuAsync
methods.description: Builds a navigation menu asynchronously based on a menu name and action context, merging, authorizing, and computing URLs for menu items.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Recursively merges menu items with the same caption, consolidating their properties and children.

methods.name: ComputeHref
methods.description: Computes the Href property for each menu item based on its URL and route values.

methods.name: GetUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL string from a menu item URL, route values, and action context.

methods.name: AuthorizeAsync
methods.description: Filters menu items asynchronously based on user permissions.

methods.name: Reduce
methods.description: Filters out menu items that do not have an Href or child items with an Href.

methods.name: HasHrefOrChildHref
methods.description: Checks if a menu item or any of its children has a valid Href.
